import pandas as pd
u = pd.read_csv('utilization.csv')
c = pd.read_csv('instance_catalog.csv')

# map instance type to catalog info
cat = c.set_index('instance_type')

rows=[]
for _, r in u.iterrows():
    itype = r['instance_type']
    cur = cat.loc[itype]
    req_vcpu = cur['vcpu'] * r['p95_cpu_pct']/100 / 0.7
    req_mem = cur['memory_gib'] * r['p95_mem_pct']/100 / 0.8
    fam = cur['family']
    cands = c[(c['family']==fam) & (c['vcpu']>=req_vcpu) & (c['memory_gib']>=req_mem)]
    if len(cands)==0:
        rec = itype
    else:
        rec = cands.sort_values('hourly_usd').iloc[0]['instance_type']
    rows.append((r['instance_id'], itype, rec))

df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=['id','cur','rec'])
cur_cost = df['cur'].map(cat['hourly_usd'])*730
rec_cost = df['rec'].map(cat['hourly_usd'])*730
saving = (cur_cost - rec_cost).sum()
print(saving)
print(df.head(10))

import pandas as pd
u = pd.read_csv('utilization.csv')
c = pd.read_csv('instance_catalog.csv')
cat = c.set_index('instance_type')

savings = 0.0
for _, r in u.iterrows():
    itype = r['instance_type']
    cur = cat.loc[itype]
    req_vcpu = cur['vcpu'] * r['p95_cpu_pct']/100 / 0.7
    req_mem = cur['memory_gib'] * r['p95_mem_pct']/100 / 0.8
    cands = c[(c['family']==cur['family']) & (c['vcpu']>=req_vcpu) & (c['memory_gib']>=req_mem)]
    rec = itype if len(cands)==0 else cands.sort_values('hourly_usd').iloc[0]['instance_type']
    savings += (cat.loc[itype,'hourly_usd'] - cat.loc[rec,'hourly_usd']) * 730

print(round(savings, 2))
